query:
INSERT INTO streams (streamer_id, title, description, category, stream_key, is_live, hls_url, thumbnail_url, viewer_count, started_at)
SELECT 
  id,
  'Test Gaming Stream - PROUDY.TV OG Image Demo',
  'Testing Open Graph image generation with dynamic canvas rendering',
  'Gaming',
  CONCAT('test-', REPLACE(UUID(), '-', '')),
  1,
  'https://test-streams.mux.dev/x36xhzz/x36xhzz.m3u8',
  'https://image.mux.com/x36xhzz/thumbnail.jpg',
  42,
  NOW()
FROM users 
WHERE role IN ('admin', 'streamer')
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.id, s.title, s.category, s.viewer_count, u.name as streamer_name
FROM streams s
JOIN users u ON s.streamer_id = u.id
ORDER BY s.id DESC LIMIT 1;
